name: Workwear Outfitters
old_description: Workwear Outfitters is the world’s workwear authority, and leading manufacturer of innovative work apparel and footwear. We serve the workers who dedicate their lives to making our world work better. Based in Nashville, Tennessee, the company employs more than 5,800 people in facilities spanning the globe.
about:
Workwear Outfitters is headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee. The company operates as a manufacturer of innovative work apparel and footwear, with facilities spanning the globe. While its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, the business has grown into a large-scale producer serving a worldwide workforce.

The company produces a range of workwear products, including apparel and footwear, serving millions of workers across industrial, service, and government sectors. Its global footprint encompasses multiple facilities and a workforce of more than 5,800 employees. Specific manufacturing processes, production volumes, and part numbers are not detailed in available sources.

Workwear Outfitters supplies industrial, service, and governmental workers, providing protective and functional clothing for diverse job environments. Its customer base includes organizations that outfit employees in demanding conditions, from construction sites to public service agencies. The company also offers a virtual sizing tool called Workfitter to assist with fit selection.

The company positions itself as a global authority in workwear, emphasizing innovation and protection for workers. It has developed tools such as Workfitter, a virtual sizing technology, to improve the buying experience and maintains a portfolio of brands that includes Red Kap and OOBE. These elements reflect its stated focus on leading the market through product development and worker-centric solutions.
